999008199.text:
いらっしゃいませ、永遠の夢を提供する
「メゾン・ド・バニー」へようこそ

localizations.en: Welcome to the Maison de Bunny, where we serve eternal dreams.

999008199.text: ほう、さすがに堂に入ったものだな
あっ、鏑矢様！！

これから星誕祭のパーティーでしょ？
話したら二人もついてくるって

localizations.en: We're here for the Starbirth Festival party! When I told them about it, these two insisted on coming along.

999008199.text: 助けてくれないか！　手違いで借金してしまったんだ

localizations.en: Please, you have to help me! I made a mistake and ended up in debt!

999008199.text: 本当に主に泣きつくとは、情けなや。恥を知りなされ

localizations.en: To think you'd actually go crying to our lord. How shameful. Have you no dignity?

999008199.text: ふ、二人とも、落ち着いて……？

localizations.en: P-please, both of you, calm down...?

999008199.text:
フン、余は今は客だ。店員ならば客をもてなして
みせるのが筋ではないか？

localizations.en: Hmph. Right now, I'm a customer. Shouldn't a good server be attending to their guests?

999008199.text:
は……ははーっ……！
誠心誠意、おもてなしいたします……

localizations.en: Y-yes, my lord...! I shall serve you with the utmost care...

999008199.text: 永遠さんたち、大変そう……

localizations.en: They sure seem to have their hands full...

999008199.text:
自業自得でしょ。さ、こちらへどうぞ！
お席へご案内しま～す！

localizations.en: That's what they get! Now then, right this way! Let me show you to your seats!

999008199.text: ぷはーっ！

素晴らしい飲みっぷり、
イケる口ですわね

localizations.en: My, what impressive drinking. You certainly know how to hold your liquor.

999008199.text: ふっ、そういうそなたも飲ませるのが上手いものだ

localizations.en: Heh, and you're quite skilled at pouring it.

999008199.text:
お連れの方は緊張しているのかしら？
さあ、どうぞ

localizations.en: Your companion seems a bit tense, though. Here, have some.

999008199.text: わ、私は……お構いなく

ふふ、かわいい……飲みづらいなら、
口移しで飲ませてあげましょうか？

localizations.en: Hehe, how adorable... If it's hard to drink, shall I feed it to you mouth-to-mouth?

999008199.text:
そ、そのような……！
わ、私にはもったいないことです……

localizations.en: Th-that would be...! I-I couldn't possibly...!

999008199.text:
フッ……千歳をからかうと面白いであろう。
余もよくやっておるからの

localizations.en: Heh... Chitose is quite fun to tease, isn't she? I do it all the time myself.

999008199.text:
ええ、この初心な反応……
野山に咲く白百合の花のように純朴華憐……

localizations.en: Yes, such innocent reactions... Pure and lovely as a white lily blooming in the wilderness...

999008199.text:
だがその野山は、余の所領である故……
手折るのはご遠慮願おうか

localizations.en: However, that wilderness happens to be my domain... So I'll have to ask you not to pluck the flowers.

999008199.text:
まあ、それは失礼いたしました。
フフ、では眺め、愛でるだけといたします

localizations.en: My, how rude of me. Hehe, then I shall simply gaze upon and admire them.

999008199.text: すごく、胸がどきどき、ぽかぽか……します

localizations.en: My heart is... pounding so fast, and I feel so warm...

999008199.text:
ちょっと、分かるかも……
緊張するよね……

localizations.en: I think I... understand that feeling... It makes you nervous, doesn't it...?

999008199.text:
んふふ……みんなー、楽しんでるー！？
司会進行のテスだよ！

localizations.en: Hehe... Is everyone having a good time?! Your host for the evening, Tess, here!

999008199.text:
本日は星誕祭！　辛いことや悲しいことは
今夜だけ忘れて楽しんじゃおう！　乾杯！

localizations.en: Tonight is the Starbirth Festival! Let's forget all our troubles and sorrows, just for tonight, and have some fun! Cheers!

999008199.text: 乾杯！！
